stories.title: Jury hears closing arguments in Tupac Shakur murder trial
stories.summary: A jury heard closing arguments on Monday in the trial of a former Los Angeles gang leader accused of involvement in the sensational murder three decades ago of chart-topping rapper Tupac Shakur. Duane “Keffe D” Davis, 63, a one-time leader of the South Side Compton Crips, is accused of ordering the September 7, 1996 killing after his nephew had been beaten by members of Shakur’s entourage in Las Vegas. “Duane Davis, in the culture of gangs, could not let that stand,” prosecutor Binu Palal said....

stories.title: Going visa-free with China, Ukraine peace: Putin meets with China, India leaders
stories.summary: BISHKEK, August 31. Russian President Vladimir Putin held meetings with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Monday. Putin proposed making the visa-free regime between Russia and China permanent. At the meeting with the Russian leader, Modi suggested discussing Ukraine peace and many other issues, noting that India would continue to support all peace efforts on the Ukrainian track. TASS has compiled the key statements from Putin’s meetings with the foreign leaders. Russia is ready to work together with China to make the visa-free regime between the countries a permanent thing, if Beijing believes it to be prudent: "We are ready to work together to extend the visa-free regime on indefinitely if the Chinese side deems this possible and beneficial." Putin also noted that the tourist flow between the countries increased by 43% in the first half of the year thanks to the visa·free regime. Modi at his meeting with Putin proposed discussing, among other things, the Ukrainian settlement. He said that India supports any peaceful efforts to resolve the situation in Ukraine and will continue to do so: "You know that India supports all peaceful efforts in this area. We will continue to do so in the future." Modi believes it's crucial that the fighting end in Ukraine. India also advocates resolving all problems through peaceful means; "this is what all of humanity demands, and this is India’s message," Modi said.
